claims.head: Best against best
claims.body: The Senators are near the top of the league for chance quality, and the Blues are near the top of the league at preventing dangerous shots. We think the Blues win this one.
claims.call: The Blues keep the Senators’ chances less dangerous than the league average (a 6.4% chance of scoring on the average shot).
claims.nums: Ottawa 7th for chance quality (a 6.6% chance of scoring on the average shot) · St. Louis 7th for preventing dangerous shots
claims.gist: It’s strength against strength: the Senators for chance quality, the Blues at preventing dangerous shots.

claims.head: Bring a pillow
claims.call: The game runs at fewer than 78.4 shots per 60 at 5-on-5, slower than either team’s usual.
claims.body: St. Louis plays some of the league’s slowest games, and so does Ottawa. We think this one is even quieter than either team’s usual.
claims.nums: Pace (shots per 60 at 5-on-5, both teams): St. Louis 28th (78.4), Ottawa 26th (79.2)
claims.gist: Both teams play slow, low-event hockey.
